    try:
        with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            content = f.read()
        data = json.loads(content)
        if 'emoji' in data and data['emoji']:
            return False
        title = data.get('title', '')
        if not title:
            return False
        emoji = pick_emoji(title)
        # Insert emoji after title to preserve field order
        new_content = content.replace(
            f'"title": "{title}"',
            f'"title": "{title}",\n  "emoji": "{emoji}"',
            1
        )
        if new_content == content:
            # Try with escaped title
            escaped = title.replace('"', '\\"')
            new_content = content.replace(
                f'"title": "{escaped}"',
                f'"title": "{escaped}",\n  "emoji": "{emoji}"',
                1
            )
        if new_content != content:
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(new_content)
            return True
        else:
            # Fallback: modify JSON data directly
            # Build ordered output
            data_with_emoji = {}
            for k, v in data.items():
                data_with_emoji[k] = v
                if k == 'title':
                    data_with_emoji['emoji'] = emoji
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(data_with_emoji, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
                f.write('\n')
            return True
    except Exception as e:

                if process_ticket(fp):

    try:
        with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            content = f.read()
        data = json.loads(content)
        if 'emoji' in data and data['emoji']:
            return False
        title = data.get('title', '')
        if not title:
            return False
        emoji = pick_emoji(title)
        # Insert emoji after title to preserve field order
        new_content = content.replace(
            f'"title": "{title}"',
            f'"title": "{title}",\n  "emoji": "{emoji}"',
            1

        if new_content == content:
            # Try with escaped title
            escaped = title.replace('"', '\\"')
            new_content = content.replace(
                f'"title": "{escaped}"',
                f'"title": "{escaped}",\n  "emoji": "{emoji}"',
                1
            )
        if new_content != content:
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(new_content)
            return True
        else:
            # Fallback: modify JSON data directly
            # Build ordered output
            data_with_emoji = {}
            for k, v in data.items():
                data_with_emoji[k] = v
                if k == 'title':
                    data_with_emoji['emoji'] = emoji
            with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(data_with_emoji, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

            return True
    except Exception as e:

        return False

            if f == 'ticket.json':
                fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                if process_ticket(fp):
                    count += 1
    print(f"Added emoji to {count} tickets")

#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu

# prepare-commit-msg hook: auto-generates commit messages on dev branches

# Skip if this is a merge, squash, amend, or message was already supplied
case "$COMMIT_SOURCE" in
  merge|squash|commit) exit 0 ;;
  message) exit 0 ;;
esac

repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$repo_root" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

branch="$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$branch" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only activate on branches ending with /🏗️dev
case "$branch" in
  */🏗️dev) ;;
  *) exit 0 ;;
esac

# Extract dev prefix (everything before /🏗️dev)
dev_prefix="${branch%%/🏗️dev}"

# Find the contributor json that matches this prefix
contributor_file=""
for f in "$repo_root"/.repo/🧑‍💻/*/contributor.json; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  alias_dir="$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")"
  c_emoji="$(sed -n 's/.*"emoji" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$f" | head -1)"
  if [ "$c_emoji$alias_dir" = "$dev_prefix" ]; then
    contributor_file="$f"
    break
  fi
done

if [ -z "$contributor_file" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

c_alias="$(basename "$(dirname "$contributor_file")")"
c_emoji="$(sed -n 's/.*"emoji" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$contributor_file" | head -1)"
c_name="$(sed -n 's/.*"name" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$contributor_file" | head -1)"
c_email="$(sed -n 's/.*"email" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$contributor_file" | head -1)"

# Collect staged ticket.json files
ticket_files="$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '.repo/🎫/*/ticket.json' '.repo/🎫/*/*/ticket.json' '.repo/🎫/*/*/*/ticket.json' '.repo/🎫/*/*/*/*/ticket.json' 2>/dev/null || true)"

# Current timestamp
now_year="$(date -u +%y)"
now_month="$(date -u +%m)"
now_day="$(date -u +%d)"
now_hour="$(date -u +%H)"
now_min="$(date -u +%M)"
now_sec="$(date -u +%S)"

# Subject line
subject="${c_emoji}${c_alias}🎆${now_year}🌙${now_month}☀️${now_day}⏰${now_hour}⌚${now_min}⏱️${now_sec}🚩"

# Build body: group tickets by date
body=""
if [ -n "$ticket_files" ]; then
  # Collect date+ticket pairs
  pairs=""
  for tf in $ticket_files; do
    full_path="$repo_root/$tf"
    [ -f "$full_path" ] || continue
    # Extract date from path: .repo/🎫/YY/MM/DD/SLUG/ticket.json
    rel="${tf#.repo/🎫/}"
    yy="$(echo "$rel" | cut -d/ -f1)"
    mm="$(echo "$rel" | cut -d/ -f2)"
    dd="$(echo "$rel" | cut -d/ -f3)"
    t_emoji="$(sed -n 's/.*"emoji" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$full_path" | head -1)"
    t_title="$(sed -n 's/.*"title" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$full_path" | head -1)"
    if [ -n "$t_title" ]; then
      pairs="${pairs}${yy}/${mm}/${dd}|${t_emoji:-🎫} ${t_title}
"
    fi
  done

  # Sort and group by date (most recent first)
  if [ -n "$pairs" ]; then
    current_date=""
    sorted="$(echo "$pairs" | sort -t'|' -k1,1r)"
    IFS='
'
    for line in $sorted; do
      date_part="${line%%|*}"
      ticket_part="${line#*|}"
      if [ "$date_part" != "$current_date" ]; then
        d_yy="$(echo "$date_part" | cut -d/ -f1)"
        d_mm="$(echo "$date_part" | cut -d/ -f2)"
        d_dd="$(echo "$date_part" | cut -d/ -f3)"
        body="${body}🎆${d_yy}🌙${d_mm}☀️${d_dd}
"
        current_date="$date_part"
      fi
      body="${body}- ${ticket_part}
"
    done
    unset IFS
  fi
fi

# Write the commit message
{
  printf '%s\n' "$subject"
  if [ -n "$body" ]; then
    printf '\n%s' "$body"
  fi
  printf '\nSigned-off-by: %s <%s>\n' "$c_name" "$c_email"
} > "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE"
